title: Therapeutic Family Support Worker / Parenting Practitioner
description:
Therapeutic Family Support Worker

Location: Barnsley (S71)Pay: £18 per hourType: Agency (12-week structured intervention)

About the RoleWe are seeking experienced and confident Therapeutic Family Support Workers / Parenting Practitioners to support an edge-of-care placement supporting a family in their home in Barnsley.

This is a high-impact, relationship-based role, focused on preventing breakdown by delivering consistent, therapeutic intervention within the home.

You will work as part of a structured support plan, helping the parent to develop effective parenting strategies while supporting the child's emotional and behavioural needs.

What You'll Be Doing
- Providing direct, relationship-based support to both parent and child within the family home
- Modelling and promoting positive parenting approaches and routines
- Supporting emotional regulation, behaviour management and de-escalation
- Working to a clear intervention plan in partnership with social care professionals
- Creating a safe, consistent and structured environment
- Supporting daily activities, engagement, and routine-building
- Recording observations and contributing to progress updates

Shift Pattern
- Early & late shift patterns 08:00 - 16:00 and 15:30 - 23:00
- Flexibility required, with occasional late shifts extending to late evening / midnight
- Rotational shift pattern as part of a wider support team

What We're Looking For
- Experience working with children and families in challenging or complex situations
- Background in roles such as:
- Family Support Worker
- Parenting Practitioner
- Youth / Outreach Worker
- Residential or Early Help services
- Strong understanding of:
- Trauma-informed practice
- Behaviour support and de-escalation techniques
- Attachment and relational working
- Ability to build trust and maintain professional boundaries
- Confidence working independently within a home environment
- Full UK driving licence (essential)

Desirable (but not essential)
- Training in Team Teach, PRICE, MAPA or similar (Training Available)
- Experience in edge-of-care / family preservation work
- Relevant qualifications (e.g. Level 3/4 Children & Young People, Health & Social Care)

What We Offer
- Competitive hourly rate with weekly pay
- Structured support and guidance throughout the placement
- Opportunity to work on a meaningful, outcome-focused intervention
- Further work opportunities available, as part of our wider social care team

ApplyIf you are passionate about working with families to create lasting change and preventing children entering care, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV outlining your relevant experience.

title: Waking Night Rehabilitation Support Worker
description:
Waking Night Rehabilitation Support Worker

Location: Barnsley

Salary: £13.45 per hour

Job Types: Part-time, Permanent

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Waking Night Support Worker to provide high-quality care to individuals as they recover and relearn skills after they have had an accident or injury. The work we do at Ariya Neuro Care makes a profound impact on peoples' lives.
- We have achieved the highest level of Platinum in the Investors in People Accreditation due to the development of our staff.
- We were also shortlisted for the Investors in People 'Platinum Employer of the year 2025.
- All of our CQC inspected services are rated outstanding in all areas, because we genuinely care about the people we support. If you have a passion to help others this could be a good fit for you.

The role:

We're looking for a proactive person to join our rehabilitation service on nights. Our service in Worsborough is a high-quality environment, with a focus on developing people. We provide a great induction with supportive shadowing and further development opportunities.

The role is for 30 hours per week from 10pm until 8am and the shifts are on a rota, including some weekends. Training will be during day-time hours.

The ideal candidate would be happy working both on their own and within a team, be proactive and have a good sense of humour. The team are really friendly, welcoming and supportive and there are fabulous training and development opportunities.

The waking night team support individuals to develop a good sleep/ wake cycle, and offer reassurance and support overnight. This role also involves all aspects of personal care, cleaning duties and some paperwork to prepare the service for the next day.

Join us in making a difference in the lives of those we support!

Benefits:
- Employee mentoring programme
- Free flu jabs
- Free parking
- Health & wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Store discount

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Ariya Neurocare, please do not hesitate to apply.
